verdict.rationale: Circle documents REST APIs across its products and publishes per-product OpenAPI specs (wallets, Gateway, CCTP, smart contracts, StableFX, CPN, compliance) with idempotency-key guidance for safe retries, so an AI-native user can drive it programmatically. The probe's 404s at generic openapi.json paths do not contradict this, since the specs live at /openapi/*.yaml. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the API works as documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
